rows.grounds: fused compound token taken as one accusative object; internal sandhi not split

items.question: How are teacher-attendants to be drawn from the assemblies for the daily festival?
items.inference: the verse orders attendants from assemblies after doorkeepers
uncertainties: exact internal sandhi of śāstṛpāriṣadentaṃ remains unresolved
items.plain_english: Then the teacher's attendants are taken from the assemblies, and his too.
